minutes.headline: Select Board and School Committee jointly appointed Peter Beardmore to the school committee, he must leave Fincom by Sept 30.
minutes.summary: A joint session with the School Committee interviewed the sole applicant for a school committee vacancy at length, focusing on the conflict of serving on both Finance Committee and School Committee. The appointment was made with a commitment to resign from Fincom by end of September. The board also heard about the streetlight purchase agreements, appointed an agricultural commission member, and received the town manager's report before entering executive session on police union bargaining.

what_happened.line: The Select Board and School Committee jointly appointed Peter Beardmore, the sole applicant, to the school committee until next May; one board member abstained.
The appointment came with a commitment to resign from the Finance Committee no later than September 30, 2022.
The board appointed Jennifer Duffy to the Agricultural Commission for a term expiring June 30, 2023; the term date may be modified later.
The board heard that the street light purchase price could change after signing through a true-up, and that the license to attach lights to poles has no recurring fee.
Members will put a remote-meeting legislation proposal on a later agenda ahead of the March deadline, and the 300th anniversary committee charge was deferred.

why_it_matters: The appointment fills a school committee seat that votes on the school budget, and it moves a Finance Committee member, who reviews that budget, off the committee that reviews it.
The street light purchase price can change after signing, so the final cost to the town may differ from the appropriation voted at town meeting.
watch_next: The Finance Committee resignation deadline of September 30, 2022.
A later agenda item on remote-meeting legislation, ahead of the March deadline.
